why: Lint cycle 6 (docs/v3/cycles/lint-6.md, lint-6.1 to lint-6.11 P2, lint-6.12 to lint-6.16 P3). The cycle 5 fixes hold: every lint-5 miss its row turned into a form is caught, the older seeds are caught at 703 of 746, and no rule fires on the playground, the 36 ejected primitives or the 75 valid-code marks. One fix overshot: the card shadow lint-5.2 added as a third signal reports a hand-built control (`rounded-md border px-3 py-2 shadow-sm`, shadcn v3's and Tremor's button, input and select base) as a card, three false alarms in examples/react (lint-6.3). This cycle's 167 phrasings are caught at 104, and the misses are the next spellings an agent writes: Tailwind's orientation variants, the v4 `&:is(.dark *)` self-selector, an outline as the card border, v4's container-scale widths and `size-*`, the `bg-(--x)` shorthand over an app variable, eighteen more libraries, a role-less clickable div whose stated owner (jsx-a11y) only warns while `basalt-ui lint` drops warnings, a `scale-x-(--s)` bar, an empty array in a ternary's first branch, and a circle radius the stylelint allowed list bans with no token to name. Each seed and its line are in docs/v3/cycles/lint-6/fixtures/results.md; reproduce with `zsh docs/v3/cycles/lint-6/fixtures/run.sh $PWD /tmp/lint-cycle-6` after a package build.
what: The false alarm of lint-6.3 gone, the misses of lint-6.1 to lint-6.16 caught or stated as known limits, and the two messages whose fix cannot be followed (lint-6.8's limit, lint-6.11's radius) made true.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/lint/preset.ts (the shadcn and jsx-a11y rule levels, options and messages only)
must_not_touch: packages/basalt-ui/src/css/** (the theme's class names and tokens are the input, not the change)
change: False alarm first (lint-6.3): the card shadow counts as surface-recipe's third signal only where no control signal sits beside it (a horizontal padding with `py-2` or less, a control height `h-8` to `h-10`, `inline-flex`); the three examples/react shapes (`tremor/Button.tsx:13`, `Input.tsx:12`, `Select.tsx:21`) become valid cases. Misses, each with an invalid fixture block or a stated limit in the rule's JSDoc: breakpoint-prefix reads `portrait:` and `landscape:`, and arbitrary-query reads `height`, `aspect-ratio`, `orientation` and `device-*` inside `[@media(…)]:` (lint-6.1); `DARK_VARIANT` reads an arbitrary variant that starts with `&` and holds `.dark` or the theme attribute inside `:is(…)`/`:where(…)`, comma lists included (lint-6.2); `borderedCard` reads a bare `outline`/`outline-1`/`outline-2` as the border signal (lint-6.4); fixed-width reads `w-`, `min-w-` and `basis-` with a container-scale name of `md` and up, and `size-*` above the threshold (lint-6.5); app-colour-arbitrary reads a colour utility over any custom property in the `(--x)` and `[var(--x)]` spellings (lint-6.6); import-boundary adds Chakra, `@mui/material`, `@mui/joy` and react-aria to `radix`, react-window and react-datepicker to `base-ui`, Highcharts (`highcharts-react-official`, `highcharts`), Victory and `@observablehq/plot` to `visx`, react-query, urql, wouter, use-query-params, pusher-js and ably to `data-library`, localforage and `@tanstack/query-async-storage-persister` to `persist-storage`, react-data-grid and `@mui/x-data-grid` to the table engines, showdown and react-remark to `streamdown`, and its JSDoc states the list is a denylist and the categories it covers (lint-6.7); raw-control either reads a `div`/`span` with `onClick` and no role (a handler that only calls `stopPropagation` passes), or the preset sets `jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions` and `click-events-have-key-events` to `error` with the ui/button fix, and the JSDoc limit names whichever holds it; if the preset route is taken, the playground at `app` must still report 0 (lint-6.8); html-data-marks reads `scale-x-(--x)`, `scale-y-(--x)` and `translate-*-(--x)` whose property is set from data, and `inlineSize`, `blockSize` and a `scaleX`/`scaleY` transform set from data (lint-6.9); chart-data-fallback reads an empty array in either branch of a ternary (lint-6.10); the radius allowed list admits `50%`, `9999px` and `calc(infinity * 1px)`, or its message names `rounded-full` on the element (lint-6.11). The P3s (lint-6.12 to lint-6.16) are each caught or stated: raw-heading via `createElement`, `inline-table`, `row`/`gridcell` outside a table role, `Array.from` rows, a namespace import of `basalt-ui/page`, luxon's `toRelative`, a `?` in a `to` string, `history.pushState` with a query, a spread of `opts.search`, `DOMParser` output inserted, `new Function`, `@custom-media`, a `class~=dark` attribute selector, the `bold`→`strong` and `*-foreground`→`on-*` token suggestions, a `TODO` reason, `Array.of()` as a fallback.
commits: fix: one commit per rule family in packages/basalt-ui (class, import, structure, stylelint and token check, messages).
proof: run.sh from lint cycle 6 reports every seed of lint-6.1 to lint-6.16 caught or names its stated limit, every `pass` mark silent, the probes of lint-6.4 (`rounded-ctrl outline outline-border p-4`), lint-6.5 (`w-md`, `size-120`), lint-6.6 (`text-(--brand-ink)`) and lint-6.9 (`scale-x-(--s)` with `style={{ '--s': r.share }}` in a map) reported, and sweep.sh reporting no surface-recipe finding on the three examples/react controls of lint-6.3.

No rule fires on the 75 `pass` marks of docs/v3/cycles/lint-6/fixtures, and the playground copy at `app` and `parts` reports 0 (seed report, sweep)
